[b][u]Town of Caddo: 1:13 AM[/u][/b]

Three men sit in a tourist bar, drinking and talking of their work while on vacation.

An- and so I took - hic - I took that things baby and thhhhrew it over the balcony! 
The mans friends laugh hard, struggling to keep steady on the barstools.

The bartender walks over with disdain in his eyes. He keeps telling himself he only needs to put up with them for a little longer, filter out their speech of hatred and blindness. Thankfully, he sees a black van pull into the parking lot and knows theyre finally here. A lady wearing a t-shirt and suit pants, roughly 510 walks in and heads over to the jukebox, quickly selecting a song to play. The beach rock drifts through the air of the bar as she walks over and sits a bit away from the men. 

In a smooth, calm voice, she orders an arnold palmer with ice, her voice catching the mens attention and one stands up and stumbles over to her.
 Yeeeeey ther predy ladyyyyy, would you wanna come back to my room for some funnnn? he says in a slurred voice. 

She looks at him with a look of disgust, but she doesn't look at him for too long. Leaning around him slightly, she looks past him and tilts her head slightly. 
Hey! Answer me lady! The man gets angry and gets closer to her, backing her up against a pillar.

The sound of his chin cracking rings out, as the lady right hooks him with a pair of brass knuckles. The mans companions attempt to react, but not before being subdued by two other men who entered. They tie all three up with zipties, and the lady walks over to the bartender.

Sorry you had to put up with them for so long. You told us people normally stay later this season, so we just wanted to make sure that nobody else was here but them.

She looks behind her as the man she punched groans on the ground. After giving him a hard kick to the back, she turns again to the bartender and reaches into her purse, withdrawing a black brick-looking item as well as two bills. That should cover their tab, my drink, and the rest is tips for the night. Thanks again Mendo, they will provide valuable information that well need very soon.

Mendo smiles awkwardly. My pleasure. The extra income is nice, and its nice hurting the people who hurt my father.  The lady rolls her eyes and smiles slyly. Youre so easy to read. Here, Ill give you a call in a bit. It wouldnt hurt talking more outside my work. She chuckles a little as she slides him a small card with only a phone number printed on it by a typewriter.

With that, she and the two men load the bargoers into the van and peel out of the parking lot, heading to an unmarked location.

[u][b]Isolated L.I.C. compound PO-5: 7:48 AM[/b][/u]

The woman walks down a hallway with a thin brown package in her hand, the walls a color that reminds her of a hospital she visited when she was a kid. She approaches a guarded door, nodding to the guard and punching in the code, stopping right before she finishes, remembering they changed the codes yesterday. Entering the new code, she ensures the door locks behind her before knocking on the next door in a small airlock type room. As she waits, her eyes turn to a small clipboard on the wall. She begins reading convicted of: cannibalism, three accounts of manslaughter, four accounts of false imprisonment She is interrupted while she reads however. Come in! a mans voice comes through a small slot in the door, prompting her to unlock the door and walk in. 

She enters a room that looks like a mini-appartment, with the kitchen area replaced with a bed and most of the items in the room are aged. The man walks out of the bathroom and looks at her. Do you have what I asked for? She hands him the package and he quickly takes it and opens it, walking over to his record player. It's signed as well, a collector had two and was willing to sell one. The man inspects the record itself as well as the cover and smiles. So, what is it this time? Gang members? Traffickers? I hope its a gang member. They always act tough.

Its three agents from SSE who made the mistake of talking too much. Dont kill them, just do enough to get them to talk about things. Prompt them for their investigative strategies, we need to spy on some diplomats soon. She doesn't seem scared of him, and knows that he has chosen to cooperate for this long, he will further. Okay. Ill do it.

She goes to walk out but he speaks up before she closes the door fully. Please tell the chef to add more salt to his mashed potatoes! They are way too bland She nods and says I will before closing the door.

[spoiler=The Meeting][i][u][b]Onboard Vanklyis Private Jet  10:42 AM,  Route to Lonaco[/b][/u]

The private security jet hums through clouded skies, flanked tightly by Eurofighter Typhoon 3500-X and a Dassault Rafale, both bearing Oceanice insignias.

 Above the Ocean Sea, the convoy pierces fog with sharp discipline.
Inside the cabin, the atmosphere is hushed but heavy.

President Vanklyis Adelais Herman sits at a lacquered blackwood table, a glass of sparkling water untouched beside him. Beside him, Secretary of Foreign Affairs Kirwin Vassek, flipping through briefings.
Across from them, a screen blares the Erich Stein News Network  international broadcast out of Rhenesse, neutral but invasive.

[u][b]Broadcast Segment: Night March Security Crisis  Terror Response or Tyranny?[/b][/u]

[b]Anchor (somber):[/b]

Erich Stein News  July 4th, 2025.
 The world watches the Oceanice Republic with unease after whats now called The Night March.
 State forces claim it was a necessary security crackdown targeting insurgents. Critics call it mass murder.

Footage cuts in*

 Thermal drone views of armored units flooding the streets. Gas clouds. Fleeing protestors.
 Then: muzzle flashes. Fire. Screaming silhouettes.

[b]Anchor (voiceover):[/b]
The Oceanice government stated that domestic extremist cells had infiltrated peaceful protest lines, triggering the response.

Cut to Oceanice press secretary from the day prior*
The S.S.E. was deployed to combat armed terror factions using the protest as cover.
 These are not simple demonstrators  they are radical agitators threatening national security.

Footage of Oceanice troops firing into the night*
 A building burns behind a banner reading Equal Rights for All Species.

Then a video clip from earlier that day*
 Parents crying beside body bags. No official identifications released.

[u][b]Back in the Jet  Cabin Reaction[/b][/u]
Vanklyis narrows his eyes at the screen, expression unreadable.

[b]President Vanklyis (low):[/b]
Let them spin their lies. The fire was lit the moment they dared to march without chains.

[b]Foreign Secretary Vassek (uneasy):
[/b]International opinion is shifting. Even neutral states are condemning us.
 This will come up in Valsune.

[b]President Vanklyis (flatly):[/b]
Good.

[b]Vassek (confused):[/b]
You want them to accuse us?

[b]President Vanklyis (cold):[/b]
Let them cry peace while we prepare steel.
 The more they speak, the more we know wholl stand in the way.

[b]Jet Guard:[/b]
My Führer. Landing approach initiated. Well be arriving in Valsune City in ten minutes.
The president nods. The TV is shut off*

[u][b]Valsune International Skyport  11:06 AM[/b][/u]

The Oceanice convoy lands on a secure military runway in Valsune City, capital of Lonaco.
The sleek black jet is flanked by a dozen Lonaco Royal Guard Escorts, dressed in deep navy blue, rifles lowered but hands ready.
As Vanklyis descends the stairs, chants echo in the wind

Protest on the Streets Outside Skyport
Barricades line the main road.

Hundreds of protestors  human and non-human alike  gather, shouting in multiple languages.
Some wave rainbow-claw flags. 

[b]Others carry signs:[/b]
EQUALITY ISNT A THREAT!
 FREEDOM FOR ALL SPECIES!
 NO PEACE WITH PREJUDICE!
 OCEANICE BLOODSTAINS OUR HANDS.

Banners with Adolf Vanklyis' name have already appeared  stylized in graffiti as The Man of Blood.
Tension crackles.

[b]Royal Guard Commander (to escorts):[/b]
No civilians through. Hold the line.

One furry protester ran out of the open escort and threw a middle finger at the car. 
The Lonaco Royal Guard stopped him and pulled him off the street while the crowd cheered. 
Inside the vehicle, Vanklyis watches with disdain.

[b]President Vanklyis (muttering):[/b]
Savages hiding behind civility.

[u][b]Lonaco Capitol Complex  Meeting Room, 11:43 AM[/b][/u]
A grand diplomatic room, carved from Lonacan marble, with golden etching of the Three Seas on the far wall.
The Oceanice delegation, dressed in black and crimson, takes their seats.

Across the table: the President of the ULR, flanked by his own ministers. Cool, polite, but clearly under pressure.
Aides murmur. Cameras are turned off. The doors close.
A quiet settles before the storm.

[b]ULR President (measured, diplomatic):[/b]
President Vanklyis. Welcome to Valsune.
 I trust your journey was... enlightening?

[b]President Herman (with a faint smirk):[/b]
Deeply, but the people are happy about my arrival
He laughed softly*

They shake hands  a cold, calculated gesture  as flashbulbs go off outside.
And behind closed doors the Cold War may find its next spark.
